observations.name: current deployed revision
observations.detail: Run #1649768 passed backend, frontend, release_guard and deploy. The post-rollout audit reports API image 67a9789, health ok, exact attachments volume /dev/vda2 ext4, 20345540608 available bytes against 6343294632 required, and zero upload reservations.

observations.name: schema compatibility
observations.detail: git diff --name-only 0eed259..67a9789 shows no backend or compose.yaml changes; no migration file changed in this pair. This is useful source evidence, not a read of the live schema version or proof of downgrade compatibility.

observations.name: previous local image tags
observations.detail: The trusted pre-build inventory in run #1649768 listed both voice-platform-api:0eed259 and voice-platform-web:0eed259. It does not prove they still exist at rehearsal time; inspect exact tags and image IDs again before any switch.

observations.name: trusted rollback entrypoint
observations.detail: The existing GitVerse workflow_dispatch always packages and deploys checked-out HEAD. It has no rollback target input or two-way rehearsal job. Direct production batch SSH denied the local operator key; the local Docker daemon is unavailable. No production rollback was attempted.

preconditions: Use an approved maintenance window, two independent authenticated browser observers, and a dedicated manual trusted CI job sharing the existing production concurrency group; never dispatch from an untrusted PR.

At execution time confirm master and both running API/web image tags equal the expected current SHA; inspect exact current and previous local image IDs and existing release directory before switching.

Verify the live schema migration version against both image migrators and unchanged migration source. Stop if any migration would require a down migration or the compatibility conclusion is uncertain.

Read Docker volume identities, drivers and mountpoints for postgres-data, attachments-data, caddy-data and caddy-config; audit exact attachment headroom. Record pre-existing non-sensitive test message and attachment checksums through authorized application reads, without dumping private content.
rehearsal: Start continuous timestamped browser probes in both sessions before the CI job. Capture update/maintenance warning, GET /api/v1/maintenance active state, and 503 MAINTENANCE for new voice lease admission while existing authenticated reads remain usable.

Through the trusted CI SSH boundary, invoke the current checked-in deploy-images.sh with VOICE_PLATFORM_DIR set to the verified current release directory and API_IMAGE/WEB_IMAGE set to the exact previous local SHA tags. The script must enable admission block, pass exact-volume guard, run its migration step, switch API/web and proxy, validate proxy and public health, then disable admission block.

Immediately audit the running previous API/web tags, public health and exact attachment volume with scripts/audit-attachment-volume.sh for the previous SHA. Recheck volume identities and authorized test content/checksums in both browser sessions.

Repeat the same trusted switch to exact current SHA tags and audit again. Verify both browsers recover, GET /api/v1/maintenance is inactive, new admissions succeed, and the same named volumes and test content remain available.
stop_condition: Abort before mutation if any precondition fails, including current SHA drift, missing image/release, schema uncertainty, volume identity mismatch, inadequate headroom, absent observers or concurrent deploy. During the run, a failed migration, unexpected image, lost volume, failed health, admission state stuck active, or missing browser evidence is a failed rehearsal: use the prevalidated current image restore path if safe, otherwise stop for operator diagnosis. Do not run down migrations, docker compose down -v, volume removal, pg_dump or backup jobs.
decision: The 67a9789 to 0eed259 pair is a plausible compatible-image rehearsal candidate, but the real rollback, two-browser behavior and volume persistence remain NOT_RUN. A purpose-built trusted manual job and live precondition checks are required before QA-12 can close.
